title: E.P. Royappa v. State of Tamil Nadu

content.caseIdentity: E.P. Royappa v. State of Tamil Nadu, (1974) 4 SCC 3
content.holding: Equality is antithetic to arbitrariness; arbitrary State action is inherently unequal and violates Article 14.
content.relevance: Lead authority for challenging unguided discretion, mala fide transfers, and capricious administrative orders beyond formal classification analysis.
